summary: Nez Perce NF site: a 20-foot L-4 tower dated 1933, abandoned in 1950 and now gone; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1950; the tower is gone.

events.note: 20-foot tower with an L-4 cab, dated 1933 by all four sources

evidence.supports: Lodge Point is in the Nez Perce National Forest
Forest Service list places Lodge Point 15 miles east-southeast of Kooskia
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the elevation as 4,761 feet
firelookout.com gives the elevation as 4,761 feet
Idaho County list gives the location as township 32N, range 6E, section 14
firelookout.com dates a 20-foot L-4 tower to 1933, abandoned 1950, gone
Forest Service list: 20-foot L-4 tower dated 1933, abandoned (1950 on the next line)
Idaho Fire Lookouts: L-4 cab on a 20-foot tower in 1933
Idaho County list: 20-foot tower with L-4 cab, 1933
firelookout.com lists the site as gone
FFLA Idaho list places Lodge Point at 46.11351, -115.67204 and marks it gone
Idaho Fire Lookouts files the abandoned site under drive-up

notes_for_editor: All four Idaho and Forest Service sources agree on the 1933 tower and the 1950 abandonment; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the FFLA list all say gone. Nothing describes what, if anything, remains on the site or whether it is reachable. The drive-up tag ('Drive-Up Abandoned') is from Idaho Fire Lookouts only; it is recorded in facts as visit.drive_up and does not say whether the public may visit. Elevation is 4761 ft (about 1451 m) per two sources; the record's elevation_m is null, so a human may add it. The record's agency is null; the facts take Nez Perce National Forest from firelookout.com. No staffing in any source.
